> 第23章 银甲女子（第1页）
一连两个时辰，苏辰都是在苦修《伏魔十三掌》之中度过。
境界提升，苏辰感觉对这掌法的运用也更强了几分。
苏辰停了下来，脸上不禁是露出了几分疲累之色，正准备盘膝修炼一会儿元力，休息一番，却猛然听得外面一阵喧闹之声。
“她现在中了奇淫蛇蛇囊之中的剧毒，是杀死她的大好机会！”
“如果让她恢复过来，凭她十级武君的实力，咱们死无葬身之地！”
一声声喊杀声，连带着强者奔行的音爆之声，在外面响起。
苏辰瞳孔一缩，显然也是大吃一惊，连忙探头向外面望去。
在距离此地较远处，四名黑衣人追杀着一名银甲女子。
这四名黑衣人的气势也是极为惊人，每一个都达到了武君层次！
武君级别，在邪月帝国都是一方巨擘般的存在！
不过按照这几名黑衣人的说法，这银甲女子，竟然是一名十级武君！
像这等境界的强者，只差一步，便可以跨入武王境界，成为邪月帝国之中最顶尖的强者！
皎洁月光之下，苏辰也是看清楚了这银甲女子的面容。
只是看了一眼，苏辰便是被完全吸引住，这银甲女子看上去只有二十岁左右的模样，肤若凝脂，双目如星，红唇娇艳，一头墨色长发飘散，再加上修长的身材与那飒爽的银甲，宛如女神。
只不过，此时这女神眉宇之中有了几分痛苦之色，显然是那几名黑衣人所说淫毒的原因！
虽然他很想上演一出英雄救美的好戏，不过他也清楚自己到底几斤几两。
一个武徒跟武君的差别，不亚于蝼蚁与巨象，对方一个指头都可以碾死自己数十次。
四名黑衣人不断的向着那银甲女子逼近。

银甲女子那张绝美的脸上浮现出怒容：“没想到你们也是堂堂武君，竟然如此卑鄙！
若是我有朝一日踏足武王境界，定要让你们血债血偿！”
银甲女子的身上突然爆发出了一股强大的气息，速度也是在一瞬间快了数倍不止，她整个人化作一道银色的流光！
只是一眨眼的功夫，便是冲出了四名黑衣人的视线，钻入一片群山之中！
“别担心，她强行动用秘法，估计短时间内无法再动用元力，她身上又有淫毒，绝对跑不远！”
“咱们仔细搜，说不定很快就发现她在哪头妖兽身下承欢呢！”
苏辰正在山洞之中谨慎的观察着远处的情况，突然感觉眼前一道银光一闪，还未等他反应过来，身边便是多了一个人。
苏辰心中顿时感觉一股寒意从脚底升腾起来。
银甲女子目光冷厉，伸手便是抓住苏辰的后脖颈，提了起来，冷冷的道：“你若是敢发出一点声响，我就杀了你。”
感受到那凛然的杀机，苏辰连忙点头，如鸡啄米。

The latest chapter of Taishang Martial God Art_Chapter 23 The Woman in Silver Armor Page 1_The Taishang Martial God Art Cute Primary School Student_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 23 Woman in Silver Armor (Page 1)
For two consecutive hours, Su Chen spent his time practicing the "Thirteen Palms of Conquering Demons".
As his level improved, Su Chen felt that his use of this palm technique was a little stronger.
Su Chen stopped, with a look of fatigue on his face. He was about to cross his legs to practice Yuanli for a while and take a rest, but suddenly he heard a noise outside.
"She is now poisoned by the poison in the sac of the strange snake. This is a great opportunity to kill her!"
"If we let her recover, with her tenth-level Martial Lord strength, we will die without a place to die!"
Cries of killing, together with the sound of sonic booms of strong men running, sounded outside.
Su Chen's pupils shrank, obviously shocked, and he quickly looked outside.
Far away from here, four men in black were chasing a woman in silver armor.
The momentum of these four men in black is also extremely amazing, each of them has reached the level of a Martial Lord!
At the level of Martial Lord, he is a giant in the Evil Moon Empire!
But according to what these men in black said, this silver-armored woman turned out to be a tenth-level Martial Lord!
A strong person at this level is only one step away from entering the Martial King realm and becoming the top strong person in the Evil Moon Empire!
Under the bright moonlight, Su Chen could clearly see the face of the woman in silver armor.
After just one glance, Su Chen was completely attracted. This silver-armored woman looked like she was only about twenty years old. Her skin was like cream, her eyes were like stars, her red lips were pretty, her long black hair was flowing, and with her slender figure and sassy silver armor, she looked like a goddess.
However, at this time, there was a bit of pain in the goddess's eyebrows, which was obviously the reason for the lustful poison mentioned by those men in black!
Although he really wanted to put on a good show of a hero saving the beauty, he also knew how much he weighed.
The difference between a martial disciple and a martial lord is no less than that between an ant and a giant elephant. The opponent can crush him dozens of times with one finger.
Four men in black kept approaching the woman in silver armor.
A scowl appeared on the beautiful face of the silver-armored woman: "I didn't expect that you, also a noble warrior, could be so despicable!
If I ever set foot in King Wu's realm one day, I will definitely make you pay with your blood! "
A powerful aura suddenly burst out from the body of the woman in silver armor, and her speed increased several times faster in an instant. Her whole body turned into a silver stream of light!
In just a blink of an eye, he rushed out of the sight of the four men in black and dived into the mountains!
"Don't worry, she forced herself to use the secret technique, and it is estimated that she will not be able to use her Yuan Power in a short time. There is also a poison in her body, so she will definitely not be able to run far!"
"If we search carefully, we might soon find out which monster she is sleeping with!"
Su Chen was carefully observing the situation in the distance in the cave. Suddenly, he felt a flash of silver light in front of his eyes. Before he could react, there was another person beside him.
Su Chen suddenly felt a chill rising from the soles of his feet.
The silver-armored woman's eyes were cold and stern, she reached out and grabbed the back of Su Chen's neck, lifted it up, and said coldly: "If you dare to make any sound, I will kill you."
Feeling the awe-inspiring murderous intent, Su Chen nodded quickly, like a chicken pecking at rice.
